hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); sensitive=fp.endswith('.env') and not fp.endswith('.env.example') or 'docker-compose' in fp and fp.endswith('.yml'); sys.exit(1 if sensitive else 0)"
file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.py ]]; then ruff format "$file" 2>/dev/null; fi
